hoy.titular: Two days to the final: the Pincha train in Montevideo and Andújar and Boselli will carry the Cup

foto.alt: Alexander Medina smiles during an Estudiantes training session.

hoy.resumen: The squad are training at Montevideo City Torque's complex and hold their last session on Friday. Mariano Andújar and Mauro Boselli, 2009 champions, will carry the Cup into the Centenario before Saturday's final against Palmeiras.

siete.texto: After arriving at the hotel through hundreds of fans, the squad are training at Montevideo City Torque's complex in Ciudad de la Costa: today, Thursday, from 5pm and on Friday from 10am, in the last session before the final.

siete.titulo: Club coaches leave the UNO on Friday at 7am
siete.texto: According to the club, the official coaches leave on Friday 27th at 7am (check-in from 5.30am) and the supporters' groups' coaches at midday, to speed up the border crossing: more than 6,500 people are travelling. A physical ID card or valid passport is required; the Mi Argentina digital ID is not accepted.

siete.titulo: Andújar and Boselli to walk out with the Cup
siete.texto: Two 2009 champions will carry the trophy onto the Centenario pitch minutes before kick-off: Mariano Andújar, that campaign's record-breaking goalkeeper, and Mauro Boselli, its top scorer with 8 goals.

siete.titulo: Palmeiras are in Uruguay with 28 players
siete.texto: Abel Ferreira praised the Pincha: "They are an extremely competitive side, with very experienced players". More provocatively, Argentine defender Alexander Barboza said he will win the final "in his other home, Uruguay". Paulinho, injured since October, remains a doubt.

siete.titulo: Medina travelled with a 27-man squad, Correa included
siete.texto: The squad list for the final has 27 players and includes Joaquín Correa, who is training with the ball and could get some minutes. The suspended Baltasar Rodríguez and youngsters Pierani, Pereyra and Van der Tuin also travelled.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar: Fabricio Pérez, Cetré or a back five
siete.texto: According to 0221, Fabricio Pérez is the favourite to replace Baltasar Rodríguez, with Cetré as the alternative; in City Bell Medina also tried Gastón Benedetti in a back five. The line-up will be settled on Friday, in the last training session.

siete.titulo: The squad welcomed the cycling fans
siete.texto: Facundo Mensegues and Brian Froidevaux reached Montevideo after pedalling more than 600 kilometres from La Plata, and the players welcomed them at the team base.
